While making the SVG prompt exporter match the retired PNG renderer, three fixes in a row
were wrong because font geometry was inferred from rendered images instead of read from the
font files. Each took a full implement-and-measure cycle to disprove.

1. **"Nerd Font icons are double-width."** Ported the old renderer's `doubleWidthRunes` table
   on that premise. Measured `hmtx`: every icon advances **exactly 1.000 cells** in both Hack
   Nerd Font and VictorMono NF. What actually overflows is the glyph *ink* (up to 1.83× the
   cell), by design — terminals let it bleed. `Run.Cells` was right all along.
2. **"The cell width is 28/48 = 0.5833 em."** Derived from the PNG canvas arithmetic. That 28
   came from `MeasureString(" ") >> 6`, which **truncates**; Hack's real advance is 0.6021 em.
   The original 0.6 default was accurate to 0.35% and the "fix" made it 3.1% wrong.
3. **"Line height is 1.4 em."** Reverse-engineered from reference images. Real values:
   Hack **1.1641 em**, VictorMono NF **1.4091 em** (hhea ascender − descender + lineGap). The
   constant had been fitted to the wrong font by coincidence — the references were rendered
   in Hack.

Reading a TTF for this is ~60 lines of `struct.unpack`: table directory at offset 12,
`head` for unitsPerEm at +18, `hhea` for ascender/descender/lineGap at +4, `hmtx` for
advances, `cmap` format 4/12 for codepoint→glyph. Scripts live in this session's scratchpad.

**Why:** cell width and line height differ by 10% and 21% between two fonts both in active
use, so any single hardcoded constant is wrong for one of them. They belong in options,
supplied per font, not guessed.

**How to apply:** before compensating for font behaviour, read the font. And note the
aggregate image-diff percentage was **blind** to all three — it sat at ~8.7% across every
attempt, because the harness force-fits the SVG into the PNG's dimensions. A per-row ink
profile found the real (vertical) error immediately. Pick an instrument that can see the
thing being changed; see [[omp-golden-harness-ambient-inputs]] for the same lesson about
green gates that measure nothing.

Four commits, tests and lint green, tree clean.

| commit | bug |
|---|---|
| `bc82f924` | whitespace collapsed — `xml:space="preserve"` per `<text>`, root `white-space` dropped |
| `4191d288` | icon ink overrunning the next cell — default stack now asks for `… Nerd Font Mono` first |
| `a3bbad83` | cursor drawn after the rprompt — anchored at the primary prompt's end |
| `86de20dd` | `#fff` unresolved → text painted in its own background — hex parser matches gookit |

Verified against the retired renderer on `glowsticks`, `cert`, `jandedobbeleer`, `M365Princess`: padding present, cursor in place, cert's text visible again. The full-theme sweep now reports one invisible run across all 124 themes — `powerlevel10k_modern`'s `at`, where the ANSI itself emits white-on-white.

Two things left on the table, both needing your call:

**Bug 2** — untouched, as flagged. `invert_powerline` on a segment inverts the separator that *follows* it ([engine.go:702](src/prompt/engine.go:702)), and the retired PNG renderer drew it identically. Engine change, terminal-visible.

**The gallery still jams.** `website/export_themes.mjs` passes `--font-family="Victor Mono"` explicitly, so it never sees the new default, and `website/static/fonts/VictorMono.ttf` is a plain patch — folder ink 1.693 cells. Fixing it means shipping the Mono-patched Victor Mono, which also changes the font under every code block on the site since `custom.css` maps it to `--ifm-font-family-monospace`.

Dev harness added at `tools/svg-png-compare/`: `shot.mjs` (natural-size side-by-side, no aspect forcing) and `probe-whitespace.mjs` (the Chromium measurement behind the first commit).

"""Compare two TTFs: grid metrics plus codepoint coverage."""
import struct
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[-1])
from advances import advances, cmap_lookup, tables  # noqa: E402


def describe(path):
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    t = tables(data)
    upem = struct.unpack(">H", data[t["head"][0] + 18:t["head"][0] + 20])[0]
    asc, desc, gap = struct.unpack(">hhh", data[t["hhea"][0] + 4:t["hhea"][0] + 10])
    cmap = cmap_lookup(data, t)
    _, adv = advances(data, t)
    cell = adv(cmap[0x4D])

    return {
        "name": path.replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1],
        "upem": upem,
        "cell": cell,
        "cell_em": cell / upem,
        "line_em": (asc - desc + gap) / upem,
        "codepoints": set(cmap),
    }


a, b = describe(sys.argv[1]), describe(sys.argv[2])

for f in (a, b):
    print(f"{f['name']}")
    print(f"  unitsPerEm    {f['upem']}")
    print(f"  cell width    {f['cell']} units = {f['cell_em']:.4f} em")
    print(f"  line height   {f['line_em']:.4f} em  (x1.2 = {f['line_em']*1.2:.4f})")
    print(f"  codepoints    {len(f['codepoints'])}")
    print()

only_a = a["codepoints"] - b["codepoints"]
only_b = b["codepoints"] - a["codepoints"]

print(f"only in {a['name']}: {len(only_a)}")
print(f"only in {b['name']}: {len(only_b)}")

for label, s in (("A", only_a), ("B", only_b)):
    if s and len(s) <= 20:
        print(f"  {label}: " + " ".join("U+%04X" % c for c in sorted(s)))

content.text:
Regenerated — and found why you saw nothing change.

`website/generated/themes.json` is gitignored and rebuilt by `npm run themes`; it had never been re-run since the fixes. Re-ran it: 124 themes, all now carrying `xml:space="preserve"` on every `<text>`, no `white-space` on the root, and one correctly placed cursor each.

But regenerating alone wouldn't have fixed the jamming, because the gallery renders in the site's own font and `static/fonts/VictorMono.ttf` was the **plain** Nerd Font patch. Swapped it for `VictorMono NFM` from the same Nerd Fonts 3.4.0 release. Verified it's a drop-in before committing:

| | plain (was) | Mono (now) |
|---|---|---|
| unitsPerEm | 1100 | 1100 |
| cell (`M` advance) | 600 units = 0.5455 em | 600 units = 0.5455 em |
| hhea line height | 1.4091 em | 1.4091 em |
| codepoints | 11,658 | 11,658 (zero difference either way) |
| `F07B` folder ink | 1.693 cells | 1.000 |
| `F120` terminal ink | 1.903 cells | 1.002 |

So `export_themes.mjs`'s `CELL_WIDTH`/`LINE_HEIGHT` stay correct and no glyph is lost — only the icon ink changes.

Verified by rasterizing three themes in headless Chromium with the new font at the gallery's exact metrics (`node shot.mjs --website glowsticks cert jandedobbeleer`): folder and check icons now sit in their own cell with the template's padding visible, `cert` has readable text, cursor after the primary prompt.

`97a21e85 fix(website): serve the Mono patched Victor Mono`

Two notes:

- **Hard-reload when you look.** The file kept its name, so a cached `VictorMono.ttf` will keep serving the old face.
- `cert`'s speckled blocks between segments are `U+E0C6`/`U+E0C7` — Victor Mono doesn't carry them, and neither did the retired PNG renderer's font. Not a regression, but it's a real gap if you want that theme to look right in the gallery.
